verdict.rationale: Svelte 5 runes ($state, $derived, $effect) can live in plain .svelte.js/.svelte.ts files outside components, meaning reactive logic can be exercised as plain JavaScript without rendering the DOM (svelte-docs-12, svelte-docs-6/7/8/9/10/20). However, there's no explicit first-party testing guide or unit-testing framework integration in the evidence, and a community comment notes unit testing has historically been an unclear/underdocumented area for Svelte (svelte-comm-11). Missing for 10: dedicated testing documentation/guide, explicit example of unit-testing runes with a test runner, and stronger independent confirmation that this workflow is smooth in practice.
